environment: Windows desktop, Codex Chromium in-app browser, local production build
methodology: Manual browser UI checks. Fresh navigation, 30-second motion sequence, then Homo sapiens search and selection. Narrow viewport is desktop hardware, not phone CPU/GPU emulation. First-map timing includes app bootstrap; search includes 160 ms debounce. Frame intervals are requestAnimationFrame cadence, not GPU timings. Main-thread heap excludes worker memory.

desktop.network: Unshaped localhost; browser cache may contain previously visited app assets

narrowSlowNetwork.network: Shared 1600 kbps, 150 ms added response latency, gzip, Cache-Control no-store

fungi.note: First selection of this detailed clade after the Homo sapiens check. Existing map remains displayed during preparation.

overviewMotion.note: At this viewport the overview sequence stays within the prefetched opening packet; detailed-clade motion is measured separately.
